Portrait of Sangpuy

Sangpuy, the celebrated indigenous singer known for his award-winning performances, is photographed in a studio setting wearing a matching denim jacket and wide-leg jeans. His white platform shoes and distinctive mullet haircut add a modern edge to the minimalist composition.

The neutral backdrop and soft lighting draw attention to Sangpuy’s calm expression and fashion-forward ensemble. This portrait highlights both his cultural identity and contemporary style.

sources.description:
Portrait of Puyuma Artist Sangpuy

Sangpuy, a Puyuma singer from Taiwan’s indigenous community, is seated cross-legged in a studio portrait. He wears a black tunic adorned with silver ornaments and multiple strands of beads, paired with red, intricately patterned trousers. In his hands rests a carved wooden instrument, emphasizing his musical identity.

The dark background and focused lighting draw attention to his composed expression and the vibrant details of his traditional attire. This image captures both the solemnity and pride of Taiwan’s Puyuma cultural heritage as embodied by an award-winning musician.

sources.title: 「尬電師父」走金曲紅毯？畫面曝光網笑瘋 - 鏡週刊 Mirror Media
sources.description:
桑布伊EVA Air紅毯亮相

第37屆金曲獎星光大道於台北小巨蛋外熱鬧開幕，原住民歌手桑布伊以搖滾感十足的爆炸捲髮和狼尾造型現身紅毯。他身穿寬鬆黑色皮革上衣，配戴墨鏡與金屬手錶，於EVA Air長榮航空的背景板前自信豎起大拇指，展現個人風格。

這身造型在網路上引發熱議，許多網友笑稱他神似台東玄濟宮的「尬電師父」鄔馨茹。當晚活動由陳明珠與鼓鼓（呂思緯）共同主持，眾多入圍者與表演者陸續走上紅毯，為金曲獎增添星光與話題。
